summary: Design Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on November 4, 2026, increasing capacity under its existing Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC (agent) dated April 27, 2022. The at-the-market program is raised to permit sales of up to $200,000,000 of common stock, inclusive of $66,330,496.30 already sold under the prior $100,000,000 shelf. No price per share is set; shares would be sold from time to time at prevailing market prices (last reported $10.34 on November 3, 2026), Nasdaq symbol DSGN. This is a routine shelf takedown/ATM update, not a special situation; watch dilution and selling pressure.
